scope_label: maximum expected outgoing nonconforming fraction for rectifying sampling plan
definition: The average outgoing quality limit (AOQL) is the highest average outgoing quality predicted for a rectifying sampling plan across possible incoming quality levels.
explanation: It is the peak of the plan's AOQ curve when rejected lots are inspected and nonconforming units are replaced as assumed.
AOQL describes a maximum long-run expectation under that plan, not a guarantee about every outgoing lot.
